status: synthetic threat experiment; not production validation
test_keys: deterministic Ed25519 keys derived from fixed role labels; test-only
independent_witness_model: synthetic independent scale/inspection record sourced from ground_truth; witness-role compromise can falsify its signed fields
authorization_model: honest AA enforces signatures, parent links, witness agreement and evidence_gate_v1; compromised AA can issue ACT directly
source_forgery_model: forged source documents are present before honest capture; honest witness remains ground-truth-derived unless the shared-dependency control is selected
limitations: Synthetic benchmark and authority model; no real external source or signer was used.
The experiment does not implement KMS/HSM, authenticated enrollment, durable replay state, distributed transactions, operational revocation or secure capture.
A compromised authority key is modeled as control over that role's signed claims only; the named role capabilities are explicit in the runner.
Monte Carlo uncertainty is not estimated; this is a deterministic benchmark stress test.
